message.content: ChaeSong-hwa initiates a discussion regarding a karaoke night, suggesting it as a fun alternative to their regular activities. He expresses enthusiasm for mixing things up by organizing a karaoke session, inviting his friends LiHua and WolfgangSchulz to join. He mentions that he thinks it would be enjoyable to mix things up by starting with classic songs like "Sweet Home Alabama" or "Let It Be." Additionally, he suggests incorporating some pop hits such as "Shallow" or "Shake It Off" to create a diverse and engaging evening. LiHua and WolfgangSchulz show their interest and support, with WolfgangSchulz offering to attend and letting ChaeSong-hwa know that he will be there once a date and time are set. They all agree on aiming for a Friday evening, with ChaeSong-hwa expressing excitement for the upcoming event.
